paragraphs.text:
Both Norman and Sylvia are able to hold onto their wits while 
gazing down on the scene of mayhem. Some distant part of you 
is proud of them.

With a hollow voice, you explain that you cannot stop to 
bury  Bernard  because  the  murderous  little  people  will  soon 
return. You see them weigh your words and accept the truth 
there. You are a long way from Miskatonic’s lecture rooms.
